format: C/C++ header file (JNI interface for Java Native Interface)
description: This file is a header file (.h) defining JNI functions for run statistics in TensorFlow's Android inference interface. It declares native function signatures for allocating, deleting, adding data to, and summarizing run statistics, integrating C++ utility classes with Java code.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates and returns a pointer/reference to a new run statistics object.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the run statistics object referenced by the given pointer.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a byte array of data to the run statistics object.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the run statistics.
